Section 2 – Introduction  
2.1 About IBPS: 
Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) is an autonomous body setup by Reserve Bank 
of India, Central Financial Institutions and Public Sector Banks with the vision to evolve and 
implement world class processes and systems of assessment and selection of personnel for 
recruitment / promotion / admission by (for) various client organizations, conduct relevant 
supportive research and publicise the findings.  
IBPS has acquired a unique distinction of being a premier national level Institute for 
employment testing, admission testing, training and research related to selection and 
management of human resources. It has been rendering assistance to the BFSI sector in the 
fields of employees’ selection, promotion and placement. For this purpose, the Institute has 
been designing appropriate measurement tools which are both fair and objective. 
2.2 Objective of this RFP: 
Through this RFP, IBPS proposes to select a Bidder (SI) who can supply and implement and 
manage “Supply, Implementation and Management of a comprehensive solution of Robotic 
Process Automation (RPA) and Intelligent process automation (IPA) for IBPS”. This is to 
minimize the impact of unexpected disruptions to the organization's operations.  
 
a. The objective of this RFP is to seek proposals from reputed bidders for the supply and 
implementation of an on premise solution for a comprehensive Robotic Process 
Automation (RPA), Intelligent Process Automation (IPA), and Agentic Process Automation 
(APA) platform to support and enhance the operational efficiency of the Institute of 
Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS). 
b. The initiative aims to automate various end-to-end intelligent processes across various 
operational activities of IBPS, with the objective of reducing manual effort, improving 
turnaround time, enhancing accuracy, ensuring compliance with regulatory and 
organizational requirements, and improving overall service delivery 
c. The proposed solution should leverage advanced technologies, including: 
 Artificial Intelligence (AI) including Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models 
(LLMs) 
 Machine Learning (ML) 
 Natural Language Processing (NLP) 
 Optical Character Recognition / Intelligent Character Recognition (OCR/ICR) 
 Intelligent Document Processing 
 API-based integrations and Human-in-the-Loop workflows 
d. IBPS expects a future-proof, industry-leading intelligent automation platform that aligns 
with global best practices and offers robust reporting, dashboards, and governance 
capabilities. 
 
e. To select the Bidder (SI) through the process of Technical and Commercial Evaluation 
Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS).

2.3 Bidder Responsibilities: The selected bidder shall be responsible for: 
 Design, deployment, and implementation of the solution 
 Customization and configuration as per IBPS requirements 
 Maintenance, upgrades, and technical support 
 Ensuring seamless integration with existing and third-party systems 
 Ensuring accessibility to authorized users across IBPS offices 
 Compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory, and security guidelines 
2.4 Expected Capabilities:  
IBPS expects a future-ready and industry-leading intelligent automation platform aligned with 
global best practices, with capabilities for comprehensive monitoring, reporting, dashboards, 
audit trails, and governance mechanisms.

organizations (hereinafter referred to as “Bidders”).

Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) solutions for IBPS,

Detailed specification of requirement will be available under “Scope of Work” Section - 3.
